📡 Exclusive | Ambassador praises Pakistani people’s unparalleled support for Iran

📌 Islamabad, IRNA –Iran’s Ambassador to Islamabad Reza Amiri-Moghaddam, emphasizing the growing interactions and cooperation between the two countries in various fields, commends the people of Pakistan for their unparalleled support for the Iranian nation during the US-Israeli imposed war.

In an interview with IRNA in Islamabad on Tuesday, Amiri-Moghaddam addressed a number of issues related to bilateral relations, including the goals and message of the latest visit by President Masoud Pezeshkian to Pakistan.
​
He said that Pezeshkian’s trip is the continuation of the upward trend in relations between the two brotherly countries, with the officials of both sides eagerly pursuing all aspects of bilateral cooperation.
​
Calling the support of Pakistanis for Iran and its forces “unparalleled” and “uprising-like”, the envoy hailed the people of the southeastern neighbor for their courage, especially their unanimity in securing the rights of the Iranian nation during the imposed war.
​
Amiri-Moghaddam underlined that the Pakistani government and nation could easily be considered a true partner in Iran’s powerful and decisive victory over “the Zionist-American enemy” and their Western allies.
​
Emphasizing the continued pursuit of the rights of the Iranian people, the ambassador noted that Pezeshkian, in line with the foreign policy priority, will also discuss with Pakistani officials ways to strengthen relations between the two countries.
​
He also referred to the recently-signed memorandum of understanding between Iran and the United States, saying the efforts of political and military leadership of Pakistan helped prevent the crisis created by the US and the Israeli regime from turning into a greater disaster in the region.
​
Amiri-Moghaddam noted that the MoU was the outcome of the Iranian nation’s victory against “the Western arrogance and the Zionist regime” and was achieved following the path of the martyred Leader of the Islamic Revolution and under the guidance of Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Hosseini Khamenei.
​
The ambassador spoke to the IRNA reporter as President Pezeshkian embarks on his second visit to Islamabad, where he will hold separate meetings with senior Pakistani officials to exchange views on the most important issues of concern to the two countries and ways to strengthen cooperation in different fields.

📌 Crypto Options: Buying Insurance on Price Moves

Main Points
⏺ Crypto options give you the right, but not the obligation, to buy or sell an asset at a set price
⏺ They’re used for hedging, income, and directional bets with defined risk
⏺ This post explains how options differ from simple spot or futures trades

1️⃣ Calls & Puts — call options give you the right to buy at a strike price, puts give you the right to sell at a strike price.
2️⃣ Premium — you pay an upfront fee (premium) for that right; if you don’t use it, the option can expire worthless.
3️⃣ Hedging — options can cap downside (buying puts) or lock in upside (selling calls against a position).
4️⃣ DeFi Options — on-chain protocols let you buy, sell, and structure options with smart contracts instead of brokers.
5️⃣ Defined Risk — unlike leveraged futures, your max loss as an option buyer is the premium you paid.

Final Thoughts

Crypto options turn “all or nothing” price bets into flexible strategies — more tools to shape your risk instead of just hoping the chart goes your way.
